name: siren
description: An emergency beacon with a domed cover, rotor and three light rays.
useCase: Identify emergency beacons in alarm settings or equipment lists.
misuse: Pair the beacon with text to describe an alarm state or an active emergency.

16.reason: The centered dome and footing leave 1px between the upper ray and cover, with an open interior around the rotor.

24.reason: The wider dome and footing stay centered, with 1.5px below the upper ray and generous space around the rotor.
